title: dieteria rubiginosa
intro: Dieteria rubiginosa, commonly known as Purple Tansy, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Purple Tansy include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Purple Tansy include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
